summary.text: Crystal Hudson represents the 35th District on the New York City Council, which includes Crown Heights, Prospect Heights, Fort Greene and Clinton Hill in Brooklyn, and was first elected in 2021.
Her Council biography says she chairs the Committee on General Welfare.

paragraphs.text: Hudson is a lifelong Brooklynite who, according to her Council biography, entered public service after almost a decade of caring for her mother, who had Alzheimer's disease.

She has co-chaired the LGBTQIA+ Caucus and the Black, Latino and Asian Caucus, and the biography says she passed the second most bills among new members in her first term and the most of any Council Member in her second.
She says she is committed to making New York City the best place to grow older.
